collection.description: Padded practice gear stuffed with coconut fiber is restuffed after many years of use.

setup.name: The scene
setup.text: Padded practice gear stuffed with coconut fiber is restuffed after many years of use. Tucked inside, the restorers find small charms and shells left by earlier trainees, and they put every one back.
